- **≤11:** One ally within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) can take their [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) immediately after yours.
- **12-16:** Two allies within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) can take their [turns](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) immediately after yours in any order.
- **17+:** Three allies within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) can take their [turns](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) immediately after yours in any order.
